values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753674 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753674 (Restrictions: 'Vehicle Length Trailer Length is 32ft.'), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753674 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a concrete boat ramp, a toilet and primitive campsites.

note: Montana FWP fishing access site on Eureka Reservoir with designated primitive camping, 4 miles north of Choteau on US-89 (milepost 345) then 3 miles west on Teton Canyon Rd. FWP: 'Reservoir is drawn down for irrigation and water levels fluctuate seasonally.' --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms $12/$18 FAS camping, concrete ramp, toilet, primitive campsites; added the 32-ft trailer limit and 7-day stay limit. Year-round season (manual) unchanged. Not stated: site count, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), hookups (derived electric 0 left). Note corrected (it said no trailer limit is published) and trimmed of restated facilities, FCFS and fees; added FWP's drawdown caveat.
flags: Missing phone: FWP Region 4 Headquarters (Great Falls) 406-454-5840 (https://fwp.mt.gov/aboutfwp/regions/region4); the FishMT page's Contact Information section is empty.
The FishMT page's mailing-address block says 'Lease expires in 2019.' FWP may hold this site on a lease that has lapsed or been renewed; the page still lists camping and fees.
